Shipping Policy — Charges & Times

Last updated 27 October 2026

Where we ship, what it costs, and how long it takes.

Where we ship

Across India. We also ship internationally on request — write to us and we will confirm whether we can reach you and what it would cost.

What it costs

Free on orders of ₹999 and over. Below that, a flat ₹79 is added at checkout, wherever in India you are.

How long it takes

Orders are dispatched from Delhi within two business days. Delivery usually takes a further three to five days, depending on where you are. Remote pin codes take longer.

Business days are Monday to Friday. Orders placed on a weekend or a public holiday are dispatched from the next working day.

If a parcel is late or missing

Write to hello@sarvha.com with your order details and we will chase it with the courier.

Addresses

Please check your address and phone number before paying. We dispatch to the address you give us, and a wrong one usually means the parcel comes back to us.

If you spot a mistake, tell us straight away — we can usually correct it before dispatch.
